submitted.rationale: With only 3 merit measurements, I probed near FeVO4-type stoichiometry with Cr (index 29: 2.2e-7 A), the V-rich region (index 22: 3e-8 A), then the Fe-rich/Cr side (index 3: 2.3e-7 A). Index 3 had the highest measured photocurrent. V-rich compositions perform much worse.

rejected.reason: The V-rich composition gave 3e-8 A, about 7x lower.
At 2.2e-7 A it is about the same as index 3 but slightly lower.
